title: Flood Rescue
description:
With the ever changing weather patterns, you never know what could happen next. Senior Airman Aaron Hauser shows us how several Airmen were able to work together after being swept away by an unexpected crisis. Soundbites from: TSgt Adam Dixon, Flood Responder, 820th RHS,
A1C Christopher Fitzgerald, Flood Responder, 820th RHS,
A1C Christopher Jones, Flood Responder, 799th ABS. Produced by Senior Airman Aaron Hauser.
